name: shoginn-dump1090
description: dump1090 is a simple Mode S decoder for RTLSDR devices This is a docker build for flightaware's dump1090 designed to feed ADSB data from any RTLSDR USB, serial/network AVR, or BEAST device. Usage * You must provide the path to the radio device using the RTL-SDR Device mapping. Refer to the support thread for instructions on how to find and provide a USB device for this mapping. * Ports for raw/beast output consumption have defaults provided. Clients will use these ports to consume the data (flightaware, flightrader24, etc.)
